# Task shader stops after vertex count [S3, unofficial]

The evidence explicitly states in the 'Task Shader Step 1' section and the 'Stopping MC early' note that the task shader uses the Marching Cubes (MC) algorithm to determine occupancy and vertex counts, but stops the algorithm after generating the vertex count.
